def to_minutes(h, m):

    (to_minutes(14, 0), to_minutes(14, 30)),
    (to_minutes(16, 0), to_minutes(16, 30)),
    (to_minutes(9, 30), to_minutes(10, 0)),
    (to_minutes(10, 30), to_minutes(12, 0)),
    (to_minutes(12, 30), to_minutes(13, 30)),
    (to_minutes(14, 0), to_minutes(16, 0)),
]

#   start: integer minute of day, zero-padded output later
# Constraints:
#   09:00 <= start, start + 30 <= 17:00
#   for each participant, [start, start+30) does not overlap any busy interval

day = "Monday"

work_end = to_minutes("17:00")

    "Christine": [("09:00", "09:30"), ("11:30", "12:00"), ("13:00", "14:00"), ("15:30", "16:30")],
    "Gabriel": [],
    "Sara": [("11:30", "12:00"), ("14:30", "15:00")],

}

    name: [(to_minutes(s), to_minutes(e)) for s, e in intervals]
    for name, intervals in busy_intervals.items()
}

def has_conflict(name, start, end):
    return any(not (end <= bs or start >= be) for bs, be in busy_minutes[name])

for start in range(work_start, work_end - duration + 1):
    end = start + duration
    if all(not has_conflict(name, start, end) for name in busy_minutes):
        print([day, to_time(start), to_time(end)])
        break

import sys

def to_minutes(t):
    h, m = map(int, t.split(':'))
    return h * 60 + m

def to_hhmm(minutes):
    return f"{minutes // 60:02d}:{minutes % 60:02d}"

def overlaps(s1, e1, s2, e2):
    return s1 < e2 and e1 > s2

days = ["Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday"]
work_start = to_minutes("09:00")
work_end = to_minutes("17:00")
duration = 30

busy = {
    "Julie": {d: [] for d in days},
    "Ruth": {
        "Monday": [("09:00", "17:00")],
        "Tuesday": [("09:00", "17:00")],
        "Wednesday": [("09:00", "17:00")],
        "Thursday": [("09:00", "11:00"), ("11:30", "14:30"), ("15:00", "17:00")],
    },
}

participants = ["Julie", "Ruth"]
avoid_thursday_before = to_minutes("11:30")

valid = []
for day in days:
    for start in range(work_start, work_end - duration + 1):
        end = start + duration
        ok = True
        for p in participants:
            for bs, be in busy[p][day]:
                bs_m = to_minutes(bs)
                be_m = to_minutes(be)
                if overlaps(start, end, bs_m, be_m):
                    ok = False
                    break
            if not ok:
                break
        if ok:
            avoid = (day == "Thursday" and start < avoid_thursday_before)
            valid.append((avoid, day, start, end))

if valid:
    valid.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1], x[2]))
    _, day, start, end = valid[0]

    busy = {

# day in {Monday, Tuesday}
# start in minutes from 00:00, 30-minute meeting
# constraints:
# 1. work hours 09:00-17:00
# 2. no overlap with busy intervals
# 3. Nathan cannot meet Monday

DURATION = 30
WORK_START = 9 * 60
WORK_END = 17 * 60
DAYS = ["Monday", "Tuesday"]

busy = {...}

    day = DAYS[candidates[0][1]]
    print([day, fmt(start), fmt(start+DURATION)])
else:
    print([])
